visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a medium shot of a man with silver-dyed hair wearing a black t-shirt, sitting at a mahjong table with a focused but stagnant expression. On the left, another person's hands are visible resting on the table. The lighting is bright and even. (2) A close-up shows a woman with long blonde hair resting her chin on her hand, looking extremely bored and impatient. (3) A cut reveals another man with glasses in a black t-shirt, also leaning his head on his hand in a state of lethargy. (4) Back to the first man, he is slowly shifting tiles on the brown table surface, showing very little physical movement. (5) The woman's face is shown again; she rolls her eyes and looks toward the ceiling. (6) The man remains in a state of deep thought, his hands hovering over the tile rows. (7) The woman starts speaking, her eyebrows furrowed. (8) A fast-paced montage follows: her hands move rapidly to draw and discard tiles. She smiles broadly, revealing her teeth, and eventually reveals a winning hand with high excitement. (9) The man is shown again, still thinking, while the woman now looks dazed and half-asleep. (10) She closes her eyes and then snaps them open, looking confused. (11) The scene shifts to a bright bathroom with marble walls. The woman is in a bathtub full of white bubbles, wearing a white bikini. She holds a green bottle and smiles, applying foam to her shoulders with a wooden brush. (12) She looks directly at the camera, holding the bottle near her face and gesturing with it. (13) The scene cuts back to the mahjong table where the first man finally discards a tile.

(3) The music cuts to a soft, relaxing acoustic guitar melody with gentle splashing water sounds in the background. The woman begins a smooth, well-enunciated narration describing the relaxation of a bath. (4) The tone is warm and professional, emphasizing brand benefits over the continuous gentle BGM. (5) A final hard cut stops the music, returning to the dry clacking of a single mahjong tile and a male voice speaking in a neutral, calm conversational tone.
